why: UIEvent/MouseEvent/KeyboardEvent prototype rows a slot read is the WRONG answer for (gen_event_protos): op = a real native op called as ops[name](member, length); null = a getter answering null (the value a browser gives for a member on an event that has no target, no pseudo-element and no related element, which is every event constructed here); alias = the same private slot under a second name (`x`/`y` ARE clientX/clientY; fromElement/toElement are the legacy directions of relatedTarget and null on a constructed event; pseudoTarget is Chrome-only and null for an event from no pseudo-element). Goal W5.1 (events lane) turns these into table rows.
